title: materials.template-family.v1
description: Shape of templates/materials/<family>/family.json. A family is a dumb renderer over materials.render-model.v1 (visual spec §8, §9). server/materials-templates.mjs validates every family.json against this schema and against the hard limits in MATERIALS_BUDGETS (server/materials-fit-budget.mjs) when it loads the registry.

ladderStep.description: One fit step. drop_section:<kind> removes a resume section of that kind; drop_toolkit_group:<label> removes one toolkit row; drop_readouts removes the resume readout strip; drop_intro removes the resume intro; drop_letter_readouts and drop_pull_quote remove letter chrome; css:<token> adds a token to the sheet's data-fit attribute, which the family stylesheet maps to a tighter letter setting.

fonts.description: Every face the family sets. Each must be declared in vendor/fonts/fonts.css; nothing loads from a network at render time (rule 5).

opticalSizesIn.description: Rendered height, in inches, of a mark per shape class. Marks are never recoloured, cropped or filtered (rule 3).

hideNameBesideWordmark.description: When an employer's logo is a wordmark that already spells the name, hide the duplicate h2.company-name visually while keeping it in the text layer for ATS.

bottomMarginIn.description: The last text box must end at least this far above the sheet's bottom edge (rule 4).

resumeLadderTail.description: Family-specific resume trims, run after the shared ladder's content steps (rule 4).

budgets.description: Soft-budget overrides. They must stay inside the hard limits of MATERIALS_BUDGETS (rule 9).

letterWords.description: The letter body's word band (paragraphs only). The writer is asked for it and QA checks it; it must sit inside MATERIALS_BUDGETS.letter's hard band.

reads.description: Optional render-model fields the family reads; it must render acceptably without each of them (§8).
